newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian shares mixed, changes not expected.
newsitem.headline: Latvian shares mixed, changes not expected.

text.p: Latvian stock volume slipped on Monday with prices of leading shares mixed to lower and dealers said they expected no big changes this week.
Total turnover came to 77,000 lats against 122,000 lats and the Rietumu index slipped 0.15 percent to 175.2 points.
"Not much change can be expected this week as only three stocks, RTF, Riga Shipyard and Valmiera Glassfibre, have stabilised," Harijs Zulgis, a dealer with the Rigas Komercbank, told Reuters.
Top shares were mixed to lower with the Riga Transport Fleet (RTF), Riga Shipyard and Vlamiera Glassfibre gaining slightly.
RTF was up one santime to 1.32 lats, and Shipyard gained to 1.32 lats from 1.31 lats. They registered volumes of 17,000 lats and 16,600 lats respectively.
Valmiera added four santimes to 1.40 lats and traded 14,800 lats.

Elsewhere on the official list trade was low and stocks lost ground. Unibanka lost three santimes to 3.00 lats on trade of 2,100 lats and Staburadze traded 1,800 lats, slipping four santimes to 2.56 lats.
On the secondary list stocks were quiet and Daugavpils Chain maker was among the few traded actively.
It remained stable at 2.30 lats in volume of 13,300 lats.
